question.en: How is the electronic signal collected and read?
question.zh-cn: 电子信号如何收集与读出？

summary.en: CCD and CMOS describe sensor technologies, not body shapes or guaranteed looks.
summary.zh-cn: CCD 与 CMOS 描述传感器技术，不是机身外形或固定影像风格。

boundary.en: Separate sensor technology from size, color sampling and processing. A “CCD look” claim needs more than the sensor-family name.
boundary.zh-cn: 把传感器技术与尺寸、彩色采样和图像处理分开。“CCD 风格”不能只凭技术名称成立。

en: Both CCD and CMOS convert light into electrical signals. Conventional CCDs transfer accumulated charge through the device toward readout; CMOS designs integrate active circuitry and different addressing arrangements. Specific implementations, filters, exposure and processing also affect the result, so the family name is not a color or noise ranking.
zh-cn: CCD 与 CMOS 都把光转为电信号。常见 CCD 将积累的电荷通过器件逐级转移至读出端；CMOS 集成有源电路并采用不同寻址方式。具体实现、滤色、曝光与处理同样影响结果，技术家族名称不是色彩或噪声排名。
